quarterly_data.signal: 20-F customer concentration: in 2025 four customers each individually exceeded 10% of total net sales, together EUR 20.0 billion or 61.2% of total net sales (2024: four customers, EUR 15.2 billion or 53.8%; 2023: two customers, 53.9%). Sales to the largest customer were EUR 7,796.7 million, or 23.9% of 2025 total net sales (EUR 4,682.4 million, or 16.6%, in 2024), and the two largest customers took 38.0% of 2025 total net sales. Customers are not named. By customer location, China represented 29.1% of 2025 total net sales (36.1% in 2024), Taiwan 25.5% (15.4% in 2024) and South Korea 25.0% (22.7% in 2024).

quarterly_data.signal: 20-F product update: ASML shipped its first TWINSCAN EXE:5200B (High-NA, successor to the EXE:5000) in early April 2025, ready for high-volume manufacturing; at 175 wafers per hour it offers 60% higher productivity than the EXE:5000, with an improved EUV light source and improved projection optics developed with strategic partner Carl Zeiss SMT. In 2025 NXE:3800E systems shipped at full specification of 220 wafers per hour, a 37% improvement over the NXE:3600D, with field upgrades bringing installed systems to the same specification.

contracts.signal: ASML 20-F supplier disclosure: Carl Zeiss SMT is ASML's sole supplier of lenses, mirrors, illuminators, collectors and other critical optical components, under an exclusive arrangement; the number of lithography systems ASML can produce is limited by Carl Zeiss SMT's production capacity, and if it terminated the relationship or could not maintain optics production over a prolonged period ASML 'would effectively cease to be able to conduct our business'. ASML holds a 24.9% equity interest in Carl Zeiss SMT Holding GmbH & Co. KG and capitalizes its R&D funding to it. Advance payments to Carl Zeiss SMT GmbH stood at EUR 323.5 million (current) and EUR 868.4 million (non-current) at December 31, 2025, versus EUR 815.8 million and EUR 599.9 million a year earlier.
contracts.value: advance payments EUR 323.5 million current + EUR 868.4 million non-current (December 31, 2025)
